title: Hanging
hpi_narrative: {{patient_name}} presents after attempted hanging. Initial priorities: ABCs — airway management critical (laryngeal injury, edema, fracture). C-spine immobilization (associated cervical spine injury from hanging drop/jerk). Assess for: ligature marks on neck, stridor, dysphonia, subcutaneous emphysema. CT neck + CT head: laryngeal fracture, hyoid fracture, cervical spine injury, anoxic brain injury. Vascular: carotid dissection, jugular venous injury. Admit to ICU. After medical stabilization: psychiatry consult for suicide attempt. Safety assessment, 1:1 observation, suicide precautions.
chief_complaint: Attempted hanging, ligature marks on neck

stacks.label: CT neck + CT head
stacks.finding: Laryngeal/C-spine fracture, anoxic brain injury, vascular injury.
